properties.description:
One built change since v0.70.0: the new tool `writes_for`. A session names a Contributor once, or one call names someone in its `_meta` under `reflow2/writes_for` (which wins, and is the only way on the stateless transport), and every node written afterwards gets an AUTHORED_BY edge with role author to them. The person must already be a Contributor. Credit only; it never sets an approver. It is built into the write guard, so every write site is covered.

Minor, because it adds a tool. No schema stamp change (28 node types, 65 edge types, schema_version 1), so no upgrade note. Also carries the day's design-only records: req:persistence is retired, replaced by accepted requirements saying the design may live apart from its code but must keep a clear two-way link to where its implementation is.
properties.name: v0.71.0 — a session names who it writes for
